question: How few fixed, query-free representatives per block are sufficient to preserve the ALL-gold recall of the frozen composite's stage 2 (QMAX(B, q) = max over all nodes of B of q . e_v), at the routing level (P50) and end to end (QMAX_BALANCED_H2_PATCH1)?

P1.stated: musique, F0: CENT_NORM does NOT preserve (prior: BASE + dense centroid 0.6867 vs QMAX_F0 0.7319)

P2a.stated: musique, PRIMARY: none of CENT_MEAN, CENT_NORM, FPS_1 preserves

P2b.stated: metaqa and metaqa_phg, PRIMARY: CENT_MEAN, CENT_NORM and FPS_1 all preserve (QMAX adds nothing there)

P2c.stated: squad and squad_phg, F0: CENT_NORM does NOT preserve (prior on squad: BASE + dense centroid lost 8 / gained 1 vs BASE while QMAX_F0 is +6 over it)

P3b.stated: m* is monotone in the level: m*(ALONE) >= m*(F0) >= m*(PRIMARY) (None counts as infinity)

P3c.stated: m*(ALONE) is None: no ladder point preserves the IVF-like endpoint on all five caches

P4.stated: FPS is at least as efficient as RAND: m*_FPS <= m*_RAND at F0 and at PRIMARY

P5.stated: musique, ALONE, CENT_NORM: the gold nodes QMAX serves and the centroid drops sit farther from their block mean (higher median centroid-distance percentile) than the gold nodes both serve

P6.stated: the actual blocks are more cohesive than a size-matched random partition (size-weighted resultant length) on all five caches

what_this_does_not_decide: adoption of any variant into the frozen composite (FREEZE f81ebb84 stays as it is); either endpoint (a) or (b); an L1 re-freeze; anything on DEV_B, TEST, 2Wiki, HotpotQA or WebQSP.  A preserving m* is a calibrated efficiency candidate for a later explicit ruling, with its compute caveat.
